windowserver_motion.cursor: Actual OS cursor already included; no synthetic pointer overlay in final films.
windowserver_motion.lifecycle_ending_observed: Ordinary Music quit request -> source stopped/unavailable -> native window withdrawn. Music PID remains alive; full process termination not verified.
windowserver_motion.render_gate: Requires real native moving passages. After at least ten seconds of controls and a sustained final absent window, an editorial hold of the empty desktop is allowed. No snapshot substitute or generated animation.
windowserver_motion.alpha_policy: Only sustained final uniform backdrop becomes transparent. Earlier short native blank-text frames retain the card.
windowserver_motion.sampling: 30fps at original speed using media PTS. A 1e-8s bisect tolerance prevents floating-point boundaries from repeating/skipping source frames.
windowserver_motion.state_samples: Runtime sample elapsed is approximate; source pixels and media PTS govern visible timing.
windowserver_motion.metadata_qualification: Raw run10 withdrawalTrigger describes requested process exit; observed evidence is unavailable selection and withdrawal, not process termination.
windowserver_motion.quality_status: ACCEPTED_FOR_THIS_PRODUCT_PREVIEW; native motion, source controls and withdrawal reviewed within documented scope.
